fusions.name: Kicked Embers
fusions.desc: Kicks live embers at the first enemy ahead, dealing 12 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cometfall
fusions.desc: Leaps feet-first at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.4 times that from the full distance, and ignoring its resistances. It sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cinders in Your Wake
fusions.desc: Lays a line of flame 6 tiles long for 5 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Coal-Walker
fusions.desc: You move 6% faster, and your fire resistance rises by 15%.
